subject: Re: Executive demo — rotating on-call windows + fallback plan
body:
From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Demo Ops <demoops@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Executive demo — goal: 3-region exec attendance

Hi Evelyn / Karthik,

Thanks for working with us. We need an exec-level demo next month that includes our SVP (US, prefers mornings PT), our Head of EMEA (UK, prefers early afternoon GMT), and our APAC Director (SG, prefers late morning SGT). With DST differences coming up and a tight prep window, can Redwood propose an exec-friendly schedule that rotates who is 'on-call' for the live Q&A so we don't ask any one exec to be in the middle of the night?

Can you also include a fallback plan if one executive must drop last-minute? We will be joined by product and security for a short 30–40 minute exec portion, then a technical deep dive.

Thanks,
Maria

--
Maria Gomez
Director, Strategic Accounts
ACME Corp

---

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.com>, ACME Demo Ops <demoops@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive demo — rotating on-call windows + fallback plan

Hi Maria — great context. We can absolutely do this. I put together a short proposal and attached a time-matrix that shows three rotation patterns that respect local working hours and the upcoming DST end in Europe (last Sunday in October). Summary below; full matrix attached (proposed_time_matrix.csv).

Quick summary (30–40m exec slot + 45m tech deep dive):
- Option A — Staggered overlap (prefers minimal night hours): 08:00 PT / 16:00 GMT / 00:00 SGT (next day) — not ideal for APAC.
- Option B — Rotating on-call (recommended): rotate lead exec each week to shift the burden; single meeting scheduled at a neutral time that is tolerable for all (e.g., 11:00 PT / 19:00 GMT / 02:00 SGT) with APAC covered by a pre-recorded 15m summary plus live Q&A handled by a local principal if the exec is offline.
- Option C — Split exec portion into two 20m windows (EMEA+US, then APAC-only) to keep everyone within business hours but increases coordination.

Fallbacks we recommend:
- Pre-recorded short exec remarks and live async Q&A via Slack thread if an exec has to miss last-minute.
- Executive delegate list per region (we suggest 2 alternates each) — we included suggested alternates in the matrix.
- Automatic role handoff doc + slide (demo-playbook-v1.pdf) with named owners and phone SIPs for no-notice swaps.

Action items for ACME: confirm preferred pattern (A/B/C) and share any hard blackout dates. If you like Option B I will circulate a rotating on-call schedule for the next two months so your team can confirm availability.

Evelyn
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415 555 0192

Attachment stubs: proposed_time_matrix.csv (CSV) — rotation patterns, timezone conversions, suggested alternates; demo-playbook-v1.pdf (PDF) — role handoff checklist, fallback scripts.

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 11:21:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Executive demo — rotating on-call windows + fallback plan

+1 on Option B. We'll own the pre-record and nominate regional POCs. Two operational notes:
1) For EU DST end (Sun, 28 Oct 2028), if the meeting spans that transition week we should prefer the later UTC-aligned start so slot labels don't flip for EMEA attendees.
2) Recommend a 10-minute tech-check 48 hours prior scheduled at each exec's local business hour to confirm A/V and any firewall routes from corporate networks.

I pushed a tentative calendar placeholder ("ACME — Exec Rotating Demo — Week 1") to the link in related_links.

Karthik
VP, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

---

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Demo Ops <demoops@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Oct 2028 02:34:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Executive demo — rotating on-call windows + fallback plan

Thanks — Option B sounds workable. A couple of specifics from our side:
- Our APAC Director is flexible but prefers to avoid meetings after 21:00 SGT.
- The EMEA Head will be traveling Wed 24 Oct — blackout that day.
- We want the pre-record to be no more than 10 minutes and must include CFO-level talking points (ROI + SSO/compliance callouts).

If you can share the rotating schedule and a one-page fallback script for execs, we'll confirm alternates.

Maria

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Oct 2028 08:15:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Executive demo — rotating on-call windows + fallback plan

Thanks Maria — we'll do the short pre-record (10m) and draft the one-page fallback script for execs. A couple of operational confirmations from our side:
- We'll propose a weekly rotation for three meetings (Week A / B / C) so the burden shifts round-robin; each regional exec will be scheduled to lead the Q&A once per quarter.
- For the week of EU DST end (week starting 29 Oct) we'll lock to UTC labels on calendar invites (11:00 PT / 19:00 UTC / 02:00 SGT) and include a parenthetical local time so attendees aren't confused.
- We'll also schedule the 48h tech-checks as separate calendar events with clear joining instructions and a RedPhone contact for last-minute handoffs.

I'll attach the one-page fallback and the rotation CSV after this message (attached now).

Naomi
Program Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: proposed_time_matrix.csv; demo-playbook-v1.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@acme.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Oct 2028 09:47:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Executive demo — rotating on-call windows + fallback plan

All good from my side — I'll be on the rotation for Week B and will act as backup for APAC if needed. Two final asks:
- Can ACME confirm preferred alternates by Friday 19 Oct?
- Can we get a confirmed list of any regional blackout dates beyond 24 Oct EMEA?

If we get those two items, we can finalize invites and publish the playbook.

Thanks,
Rishi
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
